title: Hosanna – Vinod Kumar, Benjamin Johnson Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నా చిన్ని హృదయముతో నా గొప్ప దేవుని
పగిలిన నా కుండను నా కుమ్మరి యొద్దకు తెచ్చి
english: Naa chinni hrudayamtho naa goppa devunine

credits.Vocals: Pastor Vinod Kumar, Pastor Benjamin Johnson and Christ Alone Music Team

intro: Hosanna, a song of Thanksgiving is the Telugu Christian song written and tuned by Pastor Vinod Kumar, sung by Pastor Vinod Kumar and Pastor Benjamin Johnson and music composed by Moses Dany. This song was released on April 06, 2019.
